narrationTexts: Confirms the hunch: `orderTotal` taxes the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted one.
finalText:
**Suite is green: 625 passing, 0 failing.**

Only `order totals` was broken. `orderTotal` in [src/pricing.js:41](src/pricing.js:41) taxed the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted one.

Fixed by taxing `discounted` instead of `cents`. Nothing else to do.
